description: This file defines the DocumentCentricActivity class, which demonstrates usage of the Document-Centric Apps API in Android. It handles activity creation, state persistence, and launching new documents with specific intent flags.

classes.name: DocumentCentricActivity
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating how to create and manage document-centric tasks using Android's Document API, including handling intent flags, state management, and activity creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and finds the checkbox view.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current document counter into PersistableBundle for state restoration.

methods.name: createNewDocument
methods.description: Creates and starts a new document activity, adding appropriate flags based on checkbox state.

methods.name: newDocumentIntent
methods.description: Constructs an Intent to launch a new Document activity with the NEW_DOCUMENT flag.

methods.name: incrementAndGet
methods.description: Increments and returns the document counter, logging the value.
